name: mock-browser-window
blurb: Browser window mockup with configurable chrome style and sidebar.
description: A browser frame mockup supporting Chrome, Safari, and generic variants with adjustable sizes, headers, address bar, and optional sidebar positioning. Renders children as page content within the frame.
use_when: Landing pages, product demos, design portfolios, or marketing materials showcasing web interfaces.
avoid_when: When actual browser functionality is needed; this is a decorative static mockup only.
a11y: Browser frame is decorative; content accessibility depends on children components.

props.name: sidebarItems
props.type: Array<{icon?: ReactNode; label: string; active?: boolean; badge?: string | number}>
